title: TUI edit pane: first Enter should not blank other fields; cycled fields should apply on one Enter
description: Observed with the cb08a6e4 inline edit pane (landed 2026-09-22): Left/Right cycles Type/Status; the first Enter arms editing and makes the Title and Description rows render as empty buffer lines with a cursor (the shared edit buffer starts empty), so the pane looks like it wiped all other field values; a second Enter then commits through the operations layer. The values are never actually removed (the commit reloads from disk), but the intermediate state is confusing. Ask: while editing any field, render live values for rows other than the active one (buffer only for the active row); and for Type/Status (which are cycled, not typed) apply on the first Enter instead of needing arm+commit. Update r[tui-edit] SPEC text and e2e accordingly.
